answer: Sybil resistance can require each identity—whether labeled basalt, quill, or dune—to complete a Wesolowski VDF: a chain of modular squarings in which each result depends on the previous one. GPUs can compute separate chains concurrently, but cannot parallelize the steps within a chain to eliminate its elapsed-time cost. Thus, creating clones still requires completing a sequential time-lock for each identity, while verification remains compact.
